name: ghanima-at-playwright-bdd
description: This project is a starter framework for functional and E2E testing in BDD paradigm, using [Playwright](https://playwright.dev/), [Cucumber](https://cucumber.io/docs/), and [Allure](https://allurereport.org/docs/) reporting. It is designed to support scalable, maintainable, and readable automated tests using the Page Object Model (POM) pattern.
